say:2:1210639001:0.text: Sinbad, do you know who that Graveborn was?
say:2:1210639001:0.source_cn: 辛巴达认识刚才那个亡灵吗？他是谁？

say:3:1210639002:0.text: That's <style="highlight">Viperian</style>, a sorcerer from the Dead Tide Fleet... Rumor has it he dabbles in strange experiments, especially ones involving sacrifices...
say:3:1210639002:0.source_cn: 应该是死潮舰队的术士<style=highlight>...

say:4:1210639003:0.text: Experiments... involving humans?! That's far too terrifying!
say:4:1210639003:0.source_cn: 居然抓活人来做实验，这也太可怕了。

say:5:1210639004:0.text: I don't even want to imagine what could've happened to the villagers if Magister Merlin wasn't here today... You're a really good person.
say:5:1210639004:0.source_cn: 今天要不是梅林在，恐怕后果不堪设想。你……人挺好。
say:5:1210639004:0.male: I don't even want to imagine what could've happened to the villagers if Magister Merlin wasn't here today... You're a really good person.
say:5:1210639004:0.female: I don't even want to imagine what could've happened to the villagers if Magister Merlin wasn't here today... You're a really good person.

say:9:1210639005:0.text: The magister is a wonderful person, but you should remember that Chippy still hasn't forgiven you!
say:9:1210639005:0.source_cn: 主人是好人，但满满可记仇呢……
say:9:1210639005:0.male: The magister is a wonderful person, but you should remember that Chippy still hasn't forgiven you!
say:9:1210639005:0.female: The magister is a wonderful person, but you should remember that Chippy still hasn't forgiven you!

say:10:1210639006:0.text: Hey, don't worry. I told you guys I'd pay you back.
say:10:1210639006:0.source_cn: 没忘，我答应了你们，不管要什么都可以。
say:10:1210639006:0.male: Hey, don't worry. I told you guys I'd pay you back.
say:10:1210639006:0.female: Hey, don't worry. I told you guys I'd pay you back.

say:11:1210639010:1.text: Hmm... Chippy will think of what we awesome heroes deserve!
say:11:1210639010:1.source_cn: 让满满想想，我们要什么好呢……

say:12:1210639011:1.text: First! You need to apologize. Grovel on your knees! And pay back double the money you took from us!
say:12:1210639011:1.source_cn: 第一，你要向我们道歉！并且，还要把你从我们这捞走的钱加...

say:13:1210639012:1.text: I can definitely apologize, but to be honest, about the money... I'm flat broke.
say:13:1210639012:1.source_cn: 其他条件都可以，但钱嘛……咳！不好意思，真的没有。这是...

say:14:1210639013:1.text: Huuuh?? How can you have no money when you've conned so many people?!
say:14:1210639013:1.source_cn: 啊？你应该坑过很多人的钱吧？怎么可能没钱？

say:15:1210639014:1.text: No matter how much I get, it all goes towards dealing with the constant raids by the Wights. You've seen the state of the village.
say:15:1210639014:1.source_cn: 我赚的再多，也经不起水鬼三番五次的抢啊……我们村子的情...

say:16:1210639015:1.text: Hold on! Have you been using your money to help the village?
say:16:1210639015:1.source_cn: 等一下！你的钱，都拿来补贴村子了吗？

say:17:1210639016:1.text: So, you keep finding ways to make money because your village keeps getting raided? Even if it's through questionable means?!
say:17:1210639016:1.source_cn: 你们村子老是被抢，所以！辛巴达才要不停地想尽办法挣钱吗...

say:19:1210639018:1.text: Hey, even though I'm broke... you can have this.
say:19:1210639018:1.source_cn: 虽然我穷得叮当响，但是……你们可以拿上这个。
say:19:1210639018:1.male: Hey, even though I'm broke... you can have this.
say:19:1210639018:1.female: Hey, even though I'm broke... you can have this.

say:21:1210639019:1.text: Ah, a small pendant? What does it do?
say:21:1210639019:1.source_cn: 一个小吊坠？有什么用呢？

say:22:1210639020:1.text: Don't underestimate this item! In Rustport, a rusty anchor is a symbol of courage earned by facing the dangers of the sea.
say:22:1210639020:1.source_cn: 朋友，别小瞧了这个。在锈锚港，锈蚀的锚是和风浪搏击过的勋章。

say:23:1210639021:1.text: With this, you'll be respected in Rustport and welcomed wherever you go... I dream of earning it myself one day.
say:23:1210639021:1.source_cn: 戴上这个，你就是锈锚港的大英雄，到哪都会有人欢迎你，我...
say:23:1210639021:1.male: With this, you'll be respected in Rustport and welcomed wherever you go... I dream of earning it myself one day.
say:23:1210639021:1.female: With this, you'll be respected in Rustport and welcomed wherever you go... I dream of earning it myself one day.

say:26:1210639022:1.source_cn: 等一下，这不是辛巴达的东西？

say:27:1210639023:1.text: I'm not worthy of it yet.

say:28:1210639024:1.text: Don't tell me... Did you swindle someone for this too?!

say:29:1210639025:1.text: Hey! It's like you don't trust me at all!
say:29:1210639025:1.source_cn: 哈哈……我的信誉这么差劲了吗？

say:30:1210639026:1.text: Actually, this belonged to my old man. He was quite the captain. You've probably heard the villagers talk about him, right?
say:30:1210639026:1.source_cn: 其实这是我老爹的东西。他是个很厉害的船长，你们应该听村...

choice_prompt:32:1210639026.text: Actually, this belonged to my old man. He was quite the captain. You've probably heard the villagers talk about him, right?
choice_prompt:32:1210639026.source_cn: 其实这是我老爹的东西。他是个很厉害的船长，你们应该听村民说了吧？

say:33:1210639027:1.text: You're the first person to believe that. Lots of people think the opposite of him... Just for that, I know I didn't make a mistake in choosing you.
say:33:1210639027:1.source_cn: 你是第一个说他勇敢的，就冲你这句话，我就知道没送错人。
say:33:1210639027:1.male: You're the first person to believe that. Lots of people think the opposite of him... Just for that, I know I didn't make a mistake in choosing you.
say:33:1210639027:1.female: You're the first person to believe that. Lots of people think the opposite of him... Just for that, I know I didn't make a mistake in choosing you.

say:34:1210639030:1.text: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.
say:34:1210639030:1.source_cn: 吊坠拿上吧，我身上也没有比这更珍贵的东西了。
say:34:1210639030:1.male: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.
say:34:1210639030:1.female: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.

choice_prompt:35:1210639030.text: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.
choice_prompt:35:1210639030.source_cn: 吊坠拿上吧，我身上也没有比这更珍贵的东西了。
choice_prompt:35:1210639030.male: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.
choice_prompt:35:1210639030.female: Please take good care of the pendant. It's the most precious thing to me.

say:36:1210639031:1.text: Alright, with that over, I'm at your beck and call now! I'll continue paying you back however I can.
say:36:1210639031:1.source_cn: 既然拿走了我最珍贵的东西，以后我就任你们差遣啦！
say:36:1210639031:1.male: Alright, with that over, I'm at your beck and call now! I'll continue paying you back however I can.
say:36:1210639031:1.female: Alright, with that over, I'm at your beck and call now! I'll continue paying you back however I can.

choice:35:1:2.text: Feels like a lot of responsibility...
choice:35:1:2.male: Feels like a lot of responsibility...
choice:35:1:2.female: Feels like a lot of responsibility...

say:38:1210639028:1.text: He's not an ordinary sailor! He's sailed all over the world.
say:38:1210639028:1.source_cn: 老爹他不是一般的船长，他去过很多地方。
say:38:1210639028:1.male: He's not an ordinary sailor! He's sailed all over the world.
say:38:1210639028:1.female: He's not an ordinary sailor! He's sailed all over the world.

choice:32:1:2.text: I know he was a good sailor.
choice:32:1:2.male: I know he was a good sailor.
choice:32:1:2.female: I know he was a good sailor.

say:39:1210639029:1.text: Ah... That's what most people in Rustport think of him. I'm used to it by now.
say:39:1210639029:1.source_cn: 哈哈……锈锚港大部分人都这么认为，我听惯了。
say:39:1210639029:1.male: Ah... That's what most people in Rustport think of him. I'm used to it by now.
say:39:1210639029:1.female: Ah... That's what most people in Rustport think of him. I'm used to it by now.

say:40:1210639007:0.text: Remember! The only reason our great magister is here is to help innocent people, it's not for you!
say:40:1210639007:0.source_cn: 我们帮你，完全是因为村民无辜，主人不会见死不救。
say:40:1210639007:0.male: Remember! The only reason our great magister is here is to help innocent people, it's not for you!
say:40:1210639007:0.female: Remember! The only reason our great magister is here is to help innocent people, it's not for you!

say:41:1210639008:0.text: Of course, I did promise to repay you. Anything in my power, what do you want?
say:41:1210639008:0.source_cn: 之前答应过你们，你们想要什么？说吧。

say:41:1210639008:0.female: Of course, I did promise to repay you. Anything in my power, what do you want?

choice:8:1:2.text: I'm not as great as you think...
choice:8:1:2.male: I'm not as great as you think...
choice:8:1:2.female: I'm not as great as you think...

say:42:1210639009:0.source_cn: 放心，没忘，我说过，只要你救了村子，向我提什么条件都可以。
